episodes.154598: A mudslide 6 SSW Happy Camp caused the closure of highway CA 96 on 01/31/21.  It was opened to one lane of traffic on 02/02/21.
episodes.154611: A thunderstorm located along the leading edge of a cold front produced strong wind gusts as it crossed the Brevard County coast and nearshore Atlantic waters.
episodes.154667: Low pressure system moving across the southeastern U.S. with cold front extending into the eastern Gulf of Mexico causes gusty marine winds.
episodes.154947: A SW-NE oriented line of showers associated with a prefrontal trough tracked east-southeastward across the area with isolated embedded strong storms with plenty of low level shear but limited instability in place.
episodes.154950: A pre-frontal line of thunderstorms moved across NE FL during the evening hours through early morning on Feb. 1st ahead of a cold front and upper level trough. Strong shear and marginal instability supported strong wind gusts in storms.
episodes.155334: Showers and isolated thunderstorms associated with a cold front moved across South Florida. A tightening pressure gradient between the front and retreating high pressure resulted in strong gusty winds associated with these storms as they moved across the Atlantic waters.
episodes.155692: Heavy rain spread across the region during the late evening of the 29th and continued into the evening of the 30th as a low pressure system moved from the Texas Panhandle to southern Indiana. Widespread rainfall accumulations of one to two inches on already saturated soils led to another round of flooding on some of the same locations that flooded on the 25th. During the afternoon, a few strong to severe storms produced hail to the size of quarters and isolated wind damage over Barry, Lawrence and McDonald counties.
episodes.155977: The Green River remained above flood stage as a result of heavy rainfall on the 25th of January. Some low-lying areas in the flood plain were inundated, mostly fields and undeveloped woodland. The river crested on the 29th of January and fell back below flood stage on the 1st of February.
episodes.156058: Heavy rain brought flooding to the Ouachita, Black, White, and Cache Rivers in early February 2021.
